name: Feralas
summary: In Feralas, rainforest endures between Desolace, Thousand Needles, and the Veiled Sea. Mountain walls shelter an ancient wilderness of overgrown Kaldorei ruins and primordial beasts. Highborne remnants, Gordunni ogres, and rival Alliance and Horde outposts contend for its reaches.

sections.title: A Forest Untouched by the Wastes
sections.body: You enter a rainforest still green while Desolace and Thousand Needles lie dry nearby. Mountain ranges keep the wastes at bay, sheltering ancient growth beneath warm, misty air and towering waterfalls. Much of Kalimdor looked this way before the Great Sundering. Over the ages, jungle growth swallowed the monuments of the Kaldorei who once ruled here, hiding forgotten temples and pavilions beneath moss and ferns.

sections.title: The Ruins of Eldre'Thalas
sections.body: At Feralas's heart, Eldre'Thalas lies in ruins, now called Dire Maul. The Kaldorei built the city at their empire's height, but the Gordunni ogres have defiled its vast stone courtyards. The clan spreads through the valley, pillaging sacred sites, fouling pristine groves, and driving wildlife to defend its territory. Whispers speak of Highborne remnants and powers trapped for ten thousand years in Dire Maul's sealed chambers.

sections.title: The Struggle for Footholds
sections.body: Alliance and Horde expeditions have pushed into the jungle, where every crossing brings danger. At Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle, General Shandris Feathermoon leads Sentinels against the ogres and advancing naga. Farther east, Camp Mojache anchors the Horde against aggressive Woodpaw gnolls, hostile Grimtotem tauren, and relentless ogres. Neither faction controls Feralas's wild interior.

faq.answer: Dire Maul is the name now given to Eldre'Thalas, a great elven city that survived the Sundering. It declined over the ages and fell to the brutal Gordunni clan. Ogres and treacherous spirits contest its wings, where ancient Highborne secrets remain.

faq.q: How do Alliance travelers safely reach Feathermoon Stronghold?
aliases: how to get to feralas alliance
faq.answer: From Desolace, Alliance travelers can pass south through the Twin Colossals, though the beasts there are perilous. Or they can enter the sea at Sar'theris Strand and swim south along the Forgotten Coast to Sardor Isle, bypassing the dangerous road and Camp Mojache.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting the Gordunni ogres so aggressively?
faq.answer: The Gordunni ogres push out of Dire Maul, raiding supply caravans and attacking travelers across the jungle. Their war parties threaten Camp Mojache, so Horde leaders such as Belgrom Rockmaul call for swift, aggressive strikes on the clan's outposts.

The Dream Bough is one of Azeroth's four Great Trees. Its mystical natural portal links the physical world to the Emerald Dream. The green dragonflight and ancient guardians watch over it, as they do its counterparts in Ashenvale, Duskwood, and the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why are Grimtotem tauren present in Feralas?
faq.answer: A renegade sect of Grimtotem tauren keeps a compound in the wilderness, beyond Thunder Bluff's authority. They are hostile to both the Alliance and Horde, have trapped local faerie dragons, and are targets of Horde scouts.

Yes. South of the main road, The Writhing Deep is a subterranean hive swarming with silithid insectoids. Their emergence in the rainforest signals that the hive mind is spreading far beyond southern Kalimdor's deserts.

angles.text: As a night elf, you feel the weight of ancient Kaldorei civilization in Feralas. Ogres defiling sacred ruins such as Eldre'Thalas bring sorrow and anger.
As an Alliance operative, you work from Feathermoon Stronghold under Shandris Feathermoon. You watch the coast for naga and guard elven heritage.
At Camp Mojache, you help hold the Horde's frontier against Gordunni incursions, rogue Grimtotem, and Woodpaw gnolls.
As a druid, you know the Dream Bough connects Feralas to the Emerald Dream. The place is sacred, and you must guard it from corruption and defilers.
As an herbalist, you find temperate and tropical plants beneath the damp, shaded canopy, including Sungrass, Purple Lotus, and Khadgar's Whisker.
